Helper layers are a special layer that contains extra details to make the character look good. For example, if head acc 1 is a snout, it will use helper layer 1 to add a nose in front of it. if any of the head accs are ears, they will use the back helper layer.
Front helper layers are non-recolorable and will use the default color provided in the layer's costume.

Helper layer IDs are defined in "head acc help layer nonrecolorables" and "head acc help layer fullback". This is a terrible way of doing this, but the ID values are defined as follows:
if the ID is a single digit, follow by two commas
if the ID is two digits, add a comma after every digit
